reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000855 (the melody read from 000855a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 16); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Isaac B. Woodbury's dates (1819–1858) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Woodbury_Isaac (Woodbury, I. B. (Isaac Baker), 1819-1858; SELENA, 1850); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isaac_B._Woodbury agrees; CCEH's page gives only the year 1850. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000855a.nwc). The tune ends on Eb, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
